## My Document

Loading all my libraries
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
library(palmerpenguins)
library(tidyverse)
```

There are `r nrow(penguins)` individual penguin observations.

The biggest penguin is `r max(penguins$body_mass_g, na.rm = TRUE)` grams, and the smallest is `r min(penguins$body_mass_g, na.rm = TRUE)` grams
